No group better illustrates that shift than Hispanic men. They were among Trump’s biggest electoral success stories in 2024, helping Republicans argue that the old assumption that minority voters would reliably support Democrats was beginning to break down.

CNN polling analyst Harry Enten presented data this week showing how dramatically that support has changed. Trump won Hispanic men by 10 percentage points in 2024. His current net approval among them stands at minus 41, a 51-point swing. [...] On the economy, the shift is even larger.
